texts.content=\"8+Core · Laboratorio Apple de: content="8+Core · Apple lab by Stephano Portella"
texts.content=\"Apps nativas para el ecosistem: content="Native apps for the Apple ecosystem built with governed AI agents in Claude Code."
texts.Creo apps nativas para el ecosistema App: I build native apps for the Apple ecosystem with governed AI agents in Claude Code.
texts.Solo Apple, solo nativo, con agentes que: Apple only, native only, with agents that work under clear rules and human review on every change.
texts.Swift 6, SwiftUI y los frameworks de App: Swift 6, SwiftUI and Apple's frameworks, with no layers in between.
texts.Reglas, permisos y hooks que definen qué: Rules, permissions and hooks that define what each agent can do.
texts.iPhone, iPad y Mac como base; Apple Watc: iPhone, iPad and Mac as the base; Apple Watch and Vision Pro under exploration.
texts.Lo que investigo y aplico en cada app qu: What I research and apply in every app that comes out of the lab.
texts.Del proceso de negocio al App Store: UX/: From business process to the App Store: UX/UI, architecture, development and testing, each phase with a specialized subagent and my review before moving on.
texts.Archivos CLAUDE.md, reglas y convencione: CLAUDE.md files, rules and Swift and SwiftUI conventions that give the agent the same judgment I expect from a teammate.
texts.Hooks que compilan, pasan SwiftLint y co: Hooks that build, run SwiftLint and run tests on every change. Scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop and traceability of what each agent did.
texts.Swift Testing, XCTest y evals para medir: Swift Testing, XCTest and evals to measure the agent's work. Mobile security with OWASP MASVS and CI/CD, to the standard I learned in banking.
texts.Lo que Apple presenta cada año, probado: What Apple announces every year, tested in real apps from the lab.
texts.El problema, quién usará la app y por qu: The problem, who will use the app and why it should exist on Apple. I write the project rules before the first line of code.
texts.Los agentes trabajan dentro del harness:: Agents work inside the harness: context, permissions and hooks that check on every change that the code builds, follows my conventions and passes the tests.
texts.Reviso cada cambio antes de integrarlo,: I review every change before integrating it, measure the result with tests and evals, and publish to the App Store.
texts.Me formé en la Apple Developer Academy d: I trained at the Apple Developer Academy in Naples and spent more than six years in Italy building banking and payments apps.
texts.En 2026 volví a Lima y empecé a construi: In 2026 I came back to Lima and started building with AI agents with the same rigor a banking app demands.
texts.Así nace 8+Core, mi laboratorio para cre: That is how 8+Core was born, my lab for creating Apple apps with governed AI agents.
texts.Lo que suelen preguntarme sobre el labor: What people usually ask me about the lab.
texts.Es mi laboratorio personal. Aquí creo ap: It is my personal lab. Here I create my own apps for the Apple ecosystem and test how to work with AI agents in Claude Code to production standards.
texts.¿Desarrollas apps para clientes?: Do you build apps for clients?
texts.No. El laboratorio solo publica apps pro: No. The lab only publishes my own apps, free resources and training.
texts.¿Dónde consigo tus kits de Claude Code?: Where can I get your Claude Code kits?
texts.Son gratuitos. Al final de cada video en: They are free. At the end of each video on TikTok and Instagram I share the link and the key to download them.
texts.¿Puedo invitarte a dar una charla?: Can I invite you to give a talk?
texts.Sí. Hablo de gobernanza de agentes en eq: Yes. I talk about agent governance in iOS teams, Claude Code in real Swift projects and security in financial apps. Talk, panel or workshop, in Lima or online.
texts.Charlas, colaboraciones, eventos o una c: Talks, collaborations, events or a conversation about iOS.
texts.¿Buscas un líder técnico iOS? Mi trayect: Looking for an iOS tech lead? My full career is on LinkedIn.

texts.content=\"Cómo 8+Core trata los datos qu: content="How 8+Core handles the data it receives when you write by email."
texts.<p class=\"updated\">Actualizada el 11 d: Updated on November 11, 2026. This is a translation of the Spanish version, which prevails.
texts.Stephano Portella, titular de 8+Core, co: Stephano Portella, owner of 8+Core, based in Lima, Peru.
texts.Solo los que me envías al escribirme por: Only what you send me when you write to me by email: your name, your email address and what you tell me. This site has no server of its own to receive forms and does not use tracking cookies or analytics tools of its own.
texts.Para responder tu mensaje y conversar co: To reply to your message and talk with you. I do not sell your data or share it for advertising purposes.
texts.Uso proveedores de correo y alojamiento: I use email and hosting providers that may process data outside Peru.
texts.Mientras dure la conversación y hasta 12: For as long as the conversation lasts and up to 12 months after the last communication, unless the law requires keeping it longer. After that, I delete it.
texts.Puedes solicitar acceso, rectificación,: You can request access to, rectification, cancellation of or objection to the processing of your data by writing to
texts.Respondo dentro de los plazos que fija l: I respond within the time limits set by law.
texts.Si esta política cambia, actualizaré est: If this policy changes, I will update this page.
